post.description: The caller wants truck sizes, prices or availability for a move between two places or around one place on a date. Use `suggest_locations` first when the place name is ambiguous.

dropoff_location.description: Drop-off place for a one-way move. Omit for an in-town rental returned to the pickup location.

pickup_date.description: Pickup date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, from today to about eleven months out. Defaults to 30 days from today when omitted. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

pickup_location.description: `City, ST`, a US zip / Canadian postal code, or a street address, as U-Haul's form accepts.

200.description:
Quote U-Haul truck rentals for a pickup location, optional drop-off location and pickup date: the site's own per-model availability flag and rate basis (base rate, rental period, mileage rate, extra day/distance charges, allowed days and distance for one-way), disclosed environmental fees and add-on rates. `rental_type` tells a one-way move from an in-town (return to origin) rental. Prices are a snapshot at quote time in the origin market's currency; taxes and optional coverages are not included. No reservation is made.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `models` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `availability_text` | string | The site's availability wording when it gives one. |
| `availability_type` | number |  |
| `best_rate` | number |  |
| `description` | string |  |
| `fees` | object[] | Fees the site discloses per model (environmental fee). Taxes and optional coverages are not included. |
| `has_better_rate` | boolean |  |
| `hours_available` | number |  |
| `is_available` | boolean | The site's own availability flag for the origin market (the `origin.mco` area the pickup location resolves to) on the pickup date; a quote snapshot, not a hold or guarantee, and not the inventory of any one branch. Use `list_locations` for the branches near a place. |
| `model_code` | string | Two-letter U-Haul equipment code (TM 10' truck, DC 15', EL 17', TT 20', JH 26', EM 29', BP pickup, BE cargo van, MP crew-cab pickup). |
| `model_type` | number |  |
| `rate` | number | The quoted rate; null when the site does not offer the model on this move (it writes 0 there). |
| `rate_basis` | object | The site's selected rate for the model; null when it offers none. |
| `savings` | number |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
